Here's a warm, professional introduction you can send:

:::writing{variant="email" id="81642" subject="Introduction: Mark & Brandy"}
Hi Mark and Brandy,

I wanted to introduce the two of you because I think this could be a great fit.

**Mark**, meet **Brandy**. Brandy shared with me that the company managing her ads hasn't been doing a great job, and she's looking to get her campaigns turned back on as soon as possible. I immediately thought of you.

**Brandy**, meet **Mark**. Mark is with Automate Clients. We've recently started working together, and so far the experience has been fantastic. Their team has been incredibly responsive, organized, and great to work with. I told Mark about your situation and thought it would be worthwhile for you two to connect.

I'll let you both take it from here. I hope this turns into a great partnership!

Best,

Bethany
:::

:::writing{variant="chat_message" id="52741"}
Hey Mark,

Thanks so much! It's been a great experience so far, and James has been awesome to work with.

I actually referred someone to you the other day. Her name is Brandy, and I'll make a warm introduction so you two can connect. She's in desperate need of getting her ads turned back on, so I think she'd really benefit from chatting with you.

Things have been moving quickly on our end. We just interviewed our first closer and he's an absolute gem. We're really excited about him. We have four more interviews today, so hopefully we'll have our sales team in place soon.

Our onboarding process has been going really smoothly. Right now I'm just waiting on the sales scripts and VSL scripts so we can really hit the ground running.

We do have one campaign that's performing really well this week. I've had a few calls come in and actually just closed another client this morning, so that's been exciting. I'm definitely looking forward to having some closing help soon.

I'm genuinely excited about what we're building together.

One thing I'd love to pick your brain on when we get a chance is white label fulfillment. We were planning to outsource fulfillment for our clients to one of two companies, but we were just told both have pretty poor reputations. I'd love to hear your thoughts and recommendations when things settle down a bit.

Looking forward to connecting soon!
:::
